description: This file provides a utility function `apiGet` for performing authenticated GET requests to a backend API. It includes helper functions to construct URLs based on configuration, ensure proper URL formatting, append organization identifiers, and manage fetch responses with JSON or text payloads.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests, prioritizing configuration, environment variable, or defaulting to /api.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path, correctly handling absolute URLs, /api paths, and relative paths.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends the organization_id parameter to a URL if not present, using the organization ID from context or explicit parameter.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path or URL with automatic URL handling, auth headers, organization ID injection, and response parsing with JSON fallback.
